No monitors yet

Point a cron job at your project’s ping URL. The first ping creates the monitor.

# every night at 03:00, then tell vink it ran
0 3 * * * restic backup && curl -fsS https://vink.w4j.nl/ping/k7f3q9x2mzabcdefghijkl/nightly-backup?create=1

Or run vink apply -f vink.yaml to declare them all at once.
